title: Step 6 - Reinforcement Learning: Finalizing UCB Algorithm in Python

cues.en: -: All right my friends, let's finish this implementation.
cues.zh: 講師：朋友們，把這個實作完成吧。

cues.en: Indeed, we're very close to the end.
cues.zh: 真的已經快結束。

cues.en: We have already implemented step one, step two, and step three, and now we just need to finish this by updating these variables that were created and initialized,
cues.zh: 第一、第二、第三步都完成了，現在只要更新那些在大 for 迴圈之前建立並初始化的變數，

cues.en: right before this big for loop iterating through the rounds, through the users.
cues.zh: 也就是走遍各回合、各使用者的迴圈之前。

cues.en: All right, so let's start simply with this one, ads selected, which is the full list of all the ads selected over the rounds.
cues.zh: 先從簡單的 ads_selected 開始，它是各回合所選廣告的完整串列。

cues.en: So let's paste that here.
cues.zh: 貼到這裡。

cues.en: Here, I'm back inside this first for loop iterating through the rounds, and right now, how do you think we must update this ad selected variable?
cues.zh: 現在回到走遍回合的第一個 for 迴圈內，你覺得該怎麼更新 ads_selected？

cues.en: Well, simply, of course, we have to add to this list the ad that was just selected right here in this second for loop, all right?
cues.zh: 很簡單，當然要把第二個迴圈剛選出的廣告，加入串列，好嗎？

cues.en: And you know the trick.
cues.zh: 你知道技巧。

cues.en: There is this append function in Python that allows to add an element to a list, and well, that's exactly what we're gonna use now.
cues.zh: Python 的 append 可以把元素加進串列，現在正要用它。

cues.en: We're gonna add a dot here, then add append for the append function.
cues.zh: 加一個點，再加 append。

cues.en: And inside this function, you have to input the element which you want to add to this ad selected list, right?
cues.zh: 函式裡輸入想加進 ads_selected 的元素。

cues.en: And that's, of course, ad.
cues.zh: 當然就是 ad。

cues.en: That's ad variable that was computed here in this second for loop, all right?
cues.zh: 就是第二個 for 迴圈計算出的 ad 變數，好嗎？

cues.en: so that's how you update this first variable, ad selected.
cues.zh: 這就是更新第一個變數 ads_selected 的方式。

cues.en: Then, next step, well, next step is simply to update this variable now, numbers of selections, which is a list of 10 values corresponding to the 10 ads.
cues.zh: 接著更新 numbers_of_selections，這個串列有十個值，對應十個廣告。

cues.en: And for each of these values, well, you have the number of times the ad was selected up to round N, that same round N we're dealing with right now in this first for loop.
cues.zh: 每個值記錄截至回合 n，廣告被選的次數，也就是第一個迴圈目前處理的回合。

cues.en: All right, so let's paste it right here.
cues.zh: 貼到這裡。

cues.en: And now, according to you, how are we going to update this variable?
cues.zh: 你覺得怎麼更新？

cues.en: Well, since this ad was just selected in this new round, N, well, therefore we need to update the element of index ad.
cues.zh: 既然這個廣告剛在新回合 n 被選中，就要更新索引 ad 的元素。

cues.en: Basically, the index of the ad was just selected inside this numbers of selections list.
cues.zh: 也就是 numbers_of_selections 串列中，剛選中廣告的索引位置。

cues.en: We need to update that element by incrementing it by one, all right?
cues.zh: 把那個元素加一，好嗎？

cues.en: So here, not only we need to take this list numbers of selections, but we need to take mostly the element of index ad, meaning the index of the ad that was just selected.
cues.zh: 所以不只取 numbers_of_selections，主要要取索引 ad 的元素，也就是剛選中廣告的索引。

cues.en: And then, you have two ways to do this.
cues.zh: 有兩種寫法。

cues.en: The first classic way is doing a plus equals one, which increments this particular number, the element of index ad inside this numbers of selections list by one,
cues.zh: 第一種慣用方式是 += 1，把 numbers_of_selections 中索引 ad 的這個數字加一，

cues.en: or if you don't like this notation, you can simply do a equal.
cues.zh: 如果不喜歡這個寫法，也可以寫等於。

cues.en: Then you copy this again.
cues.zh: 再複製這裡。

cues.en: You paste that here, and you just add plus one.
cues.zh: 貼過來，加上 + 1。

cues.en: As you want, that's exactly the same.
cues.zh: 看你喜歡，完全相同。

cues.en: Depends on how you prefer to see it.
cues.zh: 取決於你偏好的方式。

cues.en: Okay, then let's update this variable, sums of rewards, which is the accumulated reward for each of the ads in the same list of 10 elements corresponding to the ads.
cues.zh: 接著更新 sums_of_rewards，同樣是對應十個廣告的十元素串列，記錄各自累積獎勵。

cues.en: So I'm copying this.
cues.zh: 複製。

cues.en: Then I'm pasting it here.
cues.zh: 貼到這裡。

cues.en: Then, of course, what we need to change inside this list is that element of index ad, that index of the ad that was just selected.
cues.zh: 當然，要改的是索引 ad 的元素，也就是剛選中的廣告。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 來吧。

cues.en: Let's here add in a pair of square brackets, add the index of the ad that was just selected and then same, we're gonna update it again, you know?
cues.zh: 加上方括號，裡面放剛選中廣告的索引 ad，再一樣更新。

cues.en: We're gonna take that.
cues.zh: 取出這裡。

cues.en: And then according to you, what do we have to add to this sums of rewards and especially to this element of index ad inside this sums of rewards list?
cues.zh: 你覺得要加什麼到 sums_of_rewards，尤其是串列中索引 ad 的這個元素？

cues.en: Well, that's exactly the reward that we got by selecting this ad, you know, this ad, which had the maximum upper bound.
cues.zh: 正是選取這個最大上界廣告所獲得的獎勵。

cues.en: And where do we have these rewards for each of the ads?
cues.zh: 每個廣告的獎勵在哪裡？

cues.en: Well, that's, of course, in our dataset, right?
cues.zh: 當然在資料集。

cues.en: This dataset is a simulation telling us for each user, on which ad they're gonna click.
cues.zh: 這份模擬資料告訴我們，每位使用者會點哪個廣告。

cues.en: We don't know that in reality, but this dataset is a simulation, and therefore, we have for each user and for each ad if the user clicks yes or no on the ad.
cues.zh: 現實中不知道，但這是模擬，所以每位使用者對每個廣告點或不點，都有記錄。

cues.en: And since now we know with which user we are dealing with, thanks to this round because the round here corresponds to the user, and since we also know which ad was selected,
cues.zh: 現在透過回合知道正在處理哪位使用者，因為一回合對應一人，也知道選了哪個廣告，

cues.en: because of this second for loop, well, we can directly access the reward that was just received at this particular round and for this particular ad that was selected.
cues.zh: 因為第二個迴圈選出來了，所以可以直接存取這個回合、這個廣告收到的獎勵。

cues.en: And the way to do this is simply to take here our dataset, right?
cues.zh: 方法就是取出 dataset。

cues.en: Because this is the original dataset, but remember that we created the appendix data frame and this dataset variable.
cues.zh: 這是原始資料集，但記得已在 dataset 變數中建立 pandas DataFrame。

cues.en: So we need to take our dataset, and then remember, we need to add a values in order to access a particular value of this dataset, and then we need to enter inside some pair
cues.zh: 所以取 dataset，再加 values，存取資料集特定值，再在

cues.en: of square brackets, well, first the index of the row of the cell we want to access, which is, of course, N because N corresponds to the user, meaning the row.
cues.zh: 方括號裡，先輸入要存取儲存格的列索引，當然是 n，因為 n 對應使用者，也就是列。

cues.en: And then we need to enter the index of the column of the cell we're dealing with, which is, of course, the ad that was selected because now we need to get the reward
cues.zh: 再輸入欄索引，當然是所選的 ad，因為現在要取得

cues.en: of the ad that was selected for the particular user we're dealing with right now in this first for loop.
cues.zh: 第一個迴圈目前使用者，對所選廣告的獎勵。

cues.en: And that's exactly dataset built values and ad, okay?
cues.zh: 正好是 dataset.values[n, ad]，好嗎？

cues.en: And now I'm just gonna do something so that it's really clear to you that this is the reward we got at this particular round, N.
cues.zh: 接著做個調整，讓你清楚知道這是特定回合 n 的獎勵。

cues.en: And in order to do this, I'm going to take that here, cut it, and right between these two lines of code, I'm gonna create a new variable, which I'm gonna call reward
cues.zh: 把這段剪下，在兩行之間新增變數，叫 reward，

cues.en: so that I can really highlight that this is the reward, the reward collected after showing this ad to this user, N.
cues.zh: 強調這就是把這個廣告展示給使用者 n 後獲得的獎勵。

cues.en: This is the reward, and therefore, here, I'm just gonna add reward, all right?
cues.zh: 這是 reward，因此這裡只加 reward，好嗎？

cues.en: So that you can clearly see that very important concept in reinforcement learning, you know?
cues.zh: 讓你清楚看見強化學習非常重要的概念。

cues.en: It's all about the reward, the reward that is collected at each round and then the accumulated reward.
cues.zh: 一切都是獎勵，每回合的獎勵，以及累積獎勵。

cues.en: And speaking of the accumulated reward, well, what's exactly our next step here because indeed, the last variable which we have to update
cues.zh: 說到累積獎勵，就是下一步，因為最後還要更新的變數，

cues.en: is that variable computing the total reward we get up to round N.
cues.zh: 正是計算截至回合 n 所獲總獎勵的變數。

cues.en: And now you will perfectly know how to update that total reward variable.
cues.zh: 現在你應該完全知道如何更新 total_reward。

cues.en: According to you, what do we have to do here?
cues.zh: 你覺得要怎麼做？

cues.en: Well, we just need to add to this total reward variable that last reward, which we just got at this round, N.
cues.zh: 只要把回合 n 剛得到的獎勵，加到 total_reward。

cues.en: I mean this reward of selecting the ad and showing it to the user, N, all right?
cues.zh: 也就是選取廣告並展示給使用者 n 的這個獎勵，好嗎？

cues.en: And that's it, my friends.
cues.zh: 朋友們，就是這樣。

cues.en: Now the UCB algorithm is fully implemented.
cues.zh: UCB 演算法現在完整實作了。

cues.en: If this sounds a bit overwhelming, well, I really encourage you to try to implement that fully again because really you just have to follow logic, and then everything makes sense.
cues.zh: 如果覺得有點吃不消，真的鼓勵你再試著完整實作，因為只要依循邏輯，一切都合理。

cues.en: So I understand that this is the first time we implement such a code because so far, we've only worked with libraries so it was simpler before, but you also need to know how to implement such algorithms from scratch.
cues.zh: 我了解，這是第一次寫這種程式碼，之前都使用函式庫，所以比較簡單，但也需要知道如何從零實作這類演算法。

cues.en: And so here, it's really good that we did it, but don't worry if it feels a bit overwhelming.
cues.zh: 這裡做過一次很好，如果覺得複雜，也別擔心。

cues.en: You just have to either rewatch the videos or try to re-implement this from scratch yourself, and I promise you that this will sound easy peasy, okay?
cues.zh: 只要重看影片，或自己從零再實作，保證你會覺得輕而易舉，好嗎？

cues.en: So no worries.
cues.zh: 所以不用擔心。

cues.en: Do this again if needed, and whenever you're ready, meet me in the next tutorial to plot the final histogram, which will show us exactly which ad was identified
cues.zh: 有需要就再做一次，準備好後下一堂見，畫最終長條分布圖，明確看到這個 UCB 演算法將哪個廣告辨識為

cues.en: as the best ad, the ad with the highest conversion rate by this UCB algorithm.
cues.zh: 最佳，也就是轉換率最高的廣告。

cues.en: I can't wait to show this to you, and until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 期待示範給你，在那之前，祝你享受機器學習的樂趣。
